intended_object: An implementation detail: the RAM memory layout (store) that encodes a bit-string input after a reserved register prefix, specialized to the 3-CNF syntax scanner. I inferred this from the docstring and the module.
explanation: This is an abbreviation for `spec.inputStore`, where `spec` is the typed scanner specification of the 3-CNF syntax automaton. It only fixes how the library's RAM benchmark lays out its input in registers. The literature has no standard object this would correspond to, so it is not a mathematical object.
